# order.lugaw.avenue
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">

<title>Lugaw Avenue — Order Online</title>
<style>
body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;background:#f6f7f9;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#111827}
.card{width:100%;max-width:430px;background:#fff;border-radius:24px;padding:30px 24px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}

.grab{background:#00b14f;color:white} .foodpanda{background:#d70f64;color:white} .happyapp{background:#f5a623;color:white}

</style>
</head>
<body>
